title: Q coordinates correct
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the coordinates of point Q as (0, 2d).

title: Magnetic field magnitude correct
description: Essential Criteria: The student must state the final expression for the magnetic field as B = (m v_0) / (2 q d).

title: Electric field kinematics
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply kinematics (e.g., x = 1/2 a t^2, v_y = v_0, v_x = a t) to relate displacement d, time, and the 45° exit condition.

title: Lorentz force as centripetal
description: Important Criteria: The student must apply the formula qvB = m v^2 / R, identifying the force as the source of circular motion in the magnetic field.

title: Geometry for radius
description: Important Criteria: The student must use the exit geometry (e.g., R sin α = y_Q) to relate the circular motion radius to the known coordinate 2d and the 45° angle.

title: Velocity at field entry
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the speed v of the particle as it enters the magnetic field, typically using v = v_0 / cos(45°).

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional Criteria: The student's final expressions should have consistent units (e.g., meters for coordinates, Tesla for B).

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student uses an incorrect sign for acceleration in the electric field or misidentifies the direction of the magnetic force.

title: Angle misinterpretation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize if the student misinterprets the '45° angle with the y-axis' at point Q, leading to an incorrect velocity component ratio (tan 45° ≠ 1).
